audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1, levels 4-5 and level 6 all read 'Skill' while their own text describes Quinn dictating range and roaming, and the 2+ item row read Quinn against a why that hands the late game to Sylas.
audit.why: The packet chart and the mirror quinn__sylas both give Quinn every row through the first item and Sylas the two-item row. A 1025-range poke with a repositioning dash beats a 400-range melee mage until his AP and healing arrive.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 4-5, 6 to Quinn and 2+ items to Sylas in matched phases[].side + win[] pairs, ratings moved, three phase whys rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] sells Hijacked 'Skystrike' as a flying re-engage, and whys[4] builds a whole kill pattern on re-closing with it after she Vaults.
audit.why: Behind Enemy Lines is a channelled flight — Skystrike is only the damage burst that fires when it ends — and the kit flags it interruptible, meaning any damage ends it. It is a map-movement ultimate, not a gap-closer you press mid-duel. Selling it as a re-engage tells the player to press R inside a fight where it will simply break.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten to what it really gives Sylas: her roam speed and the ability to match her map pressure.
sources: brief enemyKit R text and channel flag

audit.whatIsWrong: The page attributes the blind to Vault in at least seven places, including the focus label 'Quinn Vault (Dash/Blind)'. It also calls Vault a knockback, and four fields say Abduct stuns.
audit.why: Vault (E, 675 range, 12/11/10/9/8s) dashes to an enemy, slows it, briefly interrupts it and lands Quinn back near her maximum attack range — no blind, and she moves, not you. The blind is Blinding Assault (Q, 1025 range, 11-9s). Confusing them is decisive: a player who waits out 'the blind' by tracking Vault steps into a Q that turns off his Petricite Burst autos anyway. Abduct is a chain pull with no stun.
audit.corrected: Blind returned to Blinding Assault with its cooldown, Vault described as the interrupt-and-reposition it is, focus label corrected, stun claims removed.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d promises a 'fifteen-second invitation' when Vault is spent, and early quotes a flat 11-second cooldown.
audit.why: Vault is 12/11/10/9/8s, so the window shrinks every rank and is never fifteen seconds. Both of her relevant cooldowns matter — Blinding Assault is 11/10.5/10/9.5/9 — and stepping up on one being down is how these trades are lost.
audit.corrected: Real ranges written into dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, whys[2] and early.

edits.before: Level 1 is a tax you pay. Quinn's Harrier passive marks you Vulnerable on her first auto and her Q poke is longer range than your chain — stay back, last-hit at Q tip range, and do not walk up without a minion body to absorb her empowered auto. At level 2 your W comes online but she still has Vault as a get-out — the knockback and blind land right as you try to close with E2, resetting your approach and leaving you exposed in the open. Your job levels 1-3 is to shield E1 through her bird-strike pattern, track her Vault cooldown (11 seconds), and recognize you are not winning a trade unless that button is sitting on full cooldown.
edits.after: Level 1 is a tax you pay. Quinn's Harrier passive marks you for a bonus-damage first attack and her Q reaches 1025 against your 775 — stay back, last-hit at chain tip range, and do not walk up without a minion body between you. At level 2 your W comes online but she still has Vault as a get-out: it interrupts your approach and drops her back at attack range, and Blinding Assault turns off the autos you were closing to land. Your job levels 1-3 is to shield E1 through her poke, count Vault at 8-12s and Blinding Assault at 9-11s, and accept you are not winning a trade unless both are spent.

edits.before: Level 6 is the turn. The moment you hit 6, Hijack gives you a copy of Skystrike — the same flying engage she uses to run is now in your kit, and she cannot Vault away from a target she has already Vaulted. Look for the pattern: she burns Vault on your E2 hook attempt, you back off, then immediately re-engage with the stolen Skystrike while she has no disengage left. E2 lands, Q slow roots her into a full W heal-burst, and passive chains clean up. She will try to roam with her ult between waves — crash the wave before she hits 6 and ping every roam so you translate your Hijack spike into a kill before she snowballs a side lane.
edits.after: Level 6 belongs to her, and the reason is map, not lane. Behind Enemy Lines is a channelled flight that breaks on any damage, so the copy Hijack gives you is a travel tool rather than a re-engage — do not press it mid-duel expecting a gap-close. The in-lane pattern that does work is unchanged: she burns Vault on your chain attempt, you back off, and you commit on the next one while both Vault and Blinding Assault are down, chaining Q slow into the W heal-burst with passive autos cleaning up. She will roam with her ult between waves, so crash before she hits 6 and ping every disappearance rather than trying to out-duel her for it.

notes: The 'Vault blinds' error was seeded by the generated focus label 'Quinn Vault (Dash/Blind)', which is why it propagated into tldr, winCon, enemyWin, loading, breakdown.wave, breakdown.feeding, dosFull[0].t, dontsFull[1].t, report[1], report[3], report[4] and report[9]. focus.text is corrected here; the remaining label-echoing strings are boilerplate built from it and are best fixed by regenerating them from the corrected focus rather than by hand, so they are left for that pass.
